about_the_game:
BH Simulator – Become the King of Baggage Flow

Take control of one of the busiest and most chaotic parts of the airport — the baggage hub. In BH Simulator, you're the manager responsible for everything: from suitcase sorting to the smooth operation of conveyor systems.

Can you handle the wave of incoming flights? Or will your baggage paradise turn into a logistical nightmare?

Build Your Own System

Create and customize complex conveyor networks, connect terminals, and manage baggage flow in real time. Every decision you make affects the speed and efficiency of the entire airport.

Grow and Sign Contracts

Purchase licenses to service new airlines, unlock international routes, and increase your hub's load. The more flights you handle, the bigger the challenges!

Precision and Strategy Are Key

Unload arriving planes, prep baggage for departure, and minimize delays. Plan each step, avoid overloads, and prove you can run a flawless system.

Game Features:

  • Intuitive yet deep logistics chain-building system

  • Numerous airlines and destinations

  • Increasing difficulty as you progress

  • Contracts, upgrades, and in-game economy

  • Lively airport atmosphere

BH Simulator – Start your career in the world of baggage operations and build perfect logistics in imperfect conditions.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows (64-bit) 10
  • Processor: i5 3550 / RYZEN 5 2500X
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 960 / AMD R9 270X
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows (64-bit) 10
  • Processor: i5 7600K / Ryzen 5 2600X
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1650 / AMD 5700 XT
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 5 GB available space

short_description: BH Simulator is a fun and immersive airport logistics game. As a baggage hub manager, build efficient conveyor systems to sort, unload, and load luggage. Plan smart routes, avoid bottlenecks, and prove you're the boss of the baggage game. Can you turn chaos into perfect order?
